method: Aspire 13.5.3 empty TypeScript AppHost, started with --isolated under a run-owned root.
One real Deno RPC executable, HTTP health readiness and an in-memory Deno KV cart.
Three Checkout.GetCart requests execute KV reads and export six OTLP spans to the real dashboard over HTTPS HTTP/JSON.
MCP resolves the exact AppHost from the project root; no discovery or HTTP transport is mocked.
RPC response trace IDs, MCP snapshot IDs and time-window-filtered aspire otel traces IDs agree as complete sets.
All three real MCP tool envelopes return ready provenance; actual dashboard token, API key, endpoint and project root are absent.
A wrong project is unbound while the AppHost is live; after stopping the exact AppHost, the same reader is unbound again.
